title: Independently signed native enrollment bootstrap delegation v1
description: Canonical compact sorted JSON with Python ensure_ascii=True escaping, plus exactly one LF; envelope at most 32768 bytes and depth at most 4. Signature verification uses an independently pinned dedicated Ed25519 authorizer. Actual target request and independent issuer originals must be reverified; signed runtime/caller pins do not prove live policy or TLS admission. Schema shape is not signature verification, caller authentication, packet semantics, one-use state, issuer permission or enrollment completion. Existing exact-packet assignment semantics remain unchanged.

signatureBase64url.description: Canonical unpadded URL-safe base64 of the raw64 Ed25519 signature over ASCII(serverware/native-enrollment-bootstrap-delegation/v1) || NUL || canonical delegation JSON, without LF.

authorizerKeyId.description: SHA-256 of actual dedicated authorizer DER SPKI, not its independent PEM-file pin. Must differ from runtime CA, caller issuer/key and target issuer/key SPKI pins. Actual current policy/response-key separation still requires the cold owner.

clientTrustBundleSha256.description: Existing native ordered framed-DER trust-set commitment, never the standard PEM bundle diagnostic or a legacy runtimeManifestDigest alias.

callerPrincipalId.description: Existing native assignment caller syntax; this caller must separately authenticate with its own existing identity, not the fresh target CSR key.

ingressHost.description: Canonical lowercase DNS or literal IP under the existing native assignment host rules.

serverInstanceId.description: Canonical SPIFFE URI under the existing native assignment instance rules; query, fragment, user information and port are not accepted.

proxyEndpoint.description: Canonical literal unicast SocketAddr with nonzero port under the existing native assignment rules. Native vsock admission compares this independent cold public TCP pin; it is not an observed serving TCP endpoint or a client IP inferred from a CID.

targetPrincipalId.description: Exact .239 target principal, additionally bounded to 1024 UTF-8 bytes. Unicode is retained semantically and encoded with lowercase ensure_ascii=True escapes, including surrogate pairs. This is not the authenticated caller identity.

targetRequestSha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact original .239 canonical signed request bytes, which have no trailing LF and are at most 65536 bytes.

targetCsrSha256.description: SHA-256 of exact canonical CSR PEM bytes, at most 16384 bytes; genuine CSR and same-key request signature must be verified independently.

targetIssuerCertificateDerSha256.description: SHA-256 of the independently selected target issuer's actual DER certificate, not PEM-file bytes; it need not be the caller issuer.

targetCreatedAtEpochMs.description: Must equal the genuine target request's exact original creation time.

targetExpiresAtEpochMs.description: Must equal the genuine target request's exact expiry; positive request lifetime at most 300000 ms and entirely inside actual issuer validity.

notBeforeUnixSeconds.description: Current positive delegation interval, at most 300 seconds, wholly contained in the exact target request interval. Fractional target endpoints are not rounded outward.

expiresAtUnixSeconds.description: Strictly later than notBeforeUnixSeconds; original expiry is not renewed by processing, re-admission or a new wrapper.

requestedSans.description: Exact .239 target SAN profile: strictly sorted unique lists, 1..8 combined entries and at most 8192 aggregate UTF-8 bytes, existing canonical DNS/URI rules. Lists equal the genuine CSR and signed target request; no policy entitlement is inferred.
